parole.significato: a summertime settlement of shepherds, consisting of the shepherds' hut, the sheepfold, and the milking area (strungă)
parole.testo: Unknown. Possibly an early borrowing from Proto-Slavic *stanъ (“lodging”). Compare Bulgarian стан (stan, “camp”), Serbo-Croatian stȃn (“apartment”)); Albanian stan and Greek στάνη (stáni), also borrowings from the Proto-Slavic.
